evidence: The paper applies "a random-forest regression model from the Ranger R package (version 0.12.1) was applied to predict the optimal implantation point with hourly precision" but does not report or interpret variable importance. The 175 biomarkers used are selected from pre-identified differentially expressed genes, not ranked by random-forest impurity importance. No conclusions about feature importance, ranking, or magnitude are drawn from the random forest analysis.
